name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the agent to turn off the siren each time it starts ringing, but the clause RespondedExistence(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) does not capture this; it only requires the switch to be toggled after the siren is ringing, not each time it starts. Add a new clause to make the agent turn off the siren each time the siren starts ringing, and remove the existing clause.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the siren to be turned off when it starts ringing, but the clause RespondedExistence(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) implies that switch_toggled must happen at the same step as siren_ringing, which is not the case. The correct clause should be Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled), which means that switch_toggled happens after siren_ringing, not necessarily at the same step.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires turning off the siren whenever it starts ringing, but the hard RespondedExistence(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) clause does not make the siren turn off when it starts ringing; it is owed when the siren is already ringing. Remove the hard clause and keep the rule-only warning. Replace it with a hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) clause: the siren starts ringing and the agent turns it off on the very next move. The machine has no final state, but the warning is valid because the task requires turning off the siren unconditionally and as a hard requirement.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires a response to the siren ringing, but the clause is a RespondedExistence, which only requires the switch to be toggled before or after the siren ringing; add a ChainResponse to make the toggle happen immediately after the siren ringing, with the hard priority to make it a required response.
NO CHANGES NEEDED: the compiled machine already makes the siren stop and reward the agent for each silence.

texts: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

(u1, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u2
